deductions.description: Both items were abandoned in the study — whoever left did so without time to collect anything. This was not a planned departure.
The torn note was written on Harlow's own paper, and both reference Thursday. Harlow wrote the note — or was instructed to.
The drawer was forced and a document destroyed — someone searched this room for exactly what the note references.
The overheard voices confirmed papers were removed from this room. The torn note was what they were looking for — or what they left behind.
Lady Harrington both threatened Harlow into silence and stood to inherit the entire estate. Motive and means, confirmed.
deductions.board_label: Lady H: motive and means confirmed

deductions.description: The bribe receipt and the torn duty log tell the same story: Webb was paid to suppress Thursday's official record entirely.
Harlow named Doyle as Lady Harrington's instrument, and the ledger records two hundred pounds paid to 'D.' in the weeks before the murder.
The threatening letter and Harlow's testimony establish a clear chain: Lady Harrington hired Doyle, silenced Webb, and framed Harlow. This is the full conspiracy.
deductions.board_label: Full conspiracy — Lady H, Doyle, Webb
